articles.title: Prolonged Inflation Battle Raises Fears of Long-Term Endeavor
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve's prolonged battle against inflation may become a long-term endeavor as central bankers' forecasts suggest a "mission accomplished milestone" may be reached as late as 2029.
articles.content: The Federal Reserve's prolonged battle against inflation has raised concerns that it may become a long-term endeavor, potentially rivaling the duration of Operation Iraqi Freedom. Six years have now passed since inflation surpassed its 2% target, and central bankers' forecasts suggest a "mission accomplished milestone may be reached as late as 2029. A recent escalation in tensions between Iran and other Middle Eastern countries has added fuel to the inflation fire. The initial surge in oil prices following President Donald Trump's tariffs last year had begun to subside, but the subsequent closure of the Strait of Hormuz by Iran caused crude prices to soar once more. This disruption to global energy supplies has put pressure on refined product markets. The situation is further complicated by the strong GDP growth driven by massive investments from AI hyperscalers, which are injecting hundreds of billions of dollars into the economy each year. This influx of capital is pushing up prices and exacerbating inflationary pressures. Oil exports have largely recovered with US military protection in place, but supplies of refined products like gasoline and diesel remain tight. The ongoing conflict between Iran and other regional players has created a volatile environment that threatens to prolong the Fed's inflation fight. As a result, the central bank may struggle to achieve its price-stability goals for an extended period, potentially lasting as long as the Iraq war. The latest consumer price index for October revealed a concerning trend, as inflation rose above expectations and began to spread into various goods and services beyond energy categories. This development has left Fed officials on high alert, prompting them to consider further rate hikes. Austan Goolsbee, president of the Chicago Federal Reserve, expressed his concern over the data, describing it as borderline disturbing. His colleagues have indicated that more aggressive action is needed, with some even suggesting a significant increase of 50 basis points. The Fed's inflation-fighting efforts are now facing new challenges. The ongoing Iran conflict shows no signs of resolution, and US President Trump has made it clear that the status quo will be maintained. In a statement to reporters on Monday, he said We're just keeping it the status quo." This stance has dashed hopes for a swift end to the war, leaving policymakers to reassess their strategies. The prolonged conflict in Iran is expected to have far-reaching consequences for global markets and economies. As a result, the Fed may be forced to revise its inflation projections once again and adopt more aggressive monetary policies to combat rising prices. The central bank's efforts to achieve price stability are now facing an extended period of uncertainty. The recent shift in the Fed's forecast for inflation is a testament to the challenges it faces in maintaining price stability. In September, the Fed pushed back its projection for when inflation would fall below 2% from 2028 to 2029, citing ongoing energy price pressures and other external shocks that have impacted global markets since 2021. The Federal Reserve's efforts to combat inflation have led some central bankers to question whether their battle against price increases may never truly end. They argue that high inflation is not solely the result of external shocks but also a reflection of policy choices made by the Fed. This perspective has implications for how long policymakers will be willing to tolerate elevated prices before taking more drastic action, such as raising interest rates further. If consumers begin to expect higher prices and adjust their spending habits accordingly, it could create a self-reinforcing cycle that fuels even more inflation. In recent statements, key officials at the Fed have sounded increasingly hawkish notes, emphasizing the need to anchor inflation expectations and prevent consumers from adopting a more permissive attitude towards price increases. This shift in tone reflects concerns that an extended period of high prices may erode the central bank's credibility if it fails to reestablish its commitment to keeping prices under control. In a recent interview with CNBC, economist Austan Goolsbee underscored this concern, warning that the Fed still has significant work to do to regain its credibility on inflation. His comments were echoed by another senior official, who suggested that a 50-basis-point rate hike may be warranted if October's core consumer price data shows a notable increase. The Federal Reserve's efforts to combat inflation may be entering a prolonged period of struggle, potentially mirroring the duration of Operation Iraqi Freedom. Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan suggested that further interest rate increases could be necessary, hinting at a faster pace than previously indicated by recent hikes. Her comments came as she emphasized the current policy rate is too low and contributes to inflationary pressures. This view echoes concerns about the effectiveness of the Fed's strategy in bringing down prices. Economists like Diane Swonk are warning that the Fed's credibility on fighting inflation is at risk, particularly for consumers who rely heavily on wages rather than investments. As she pointed out on LinkedIn, the prolonged period of high inflation has been a major challenge for the central bank. The outcome remains uncertain, with many experts expecting a long and difficult battle against rising prices. The dual-200MP camera setup might seem like a major upgrade, but it's worth noting that the Magic8 Pro already had a 200MP telephoto camera. The real story here is the new main sensor and improved stabilization, which are likely to have a more significant impact on image quality than just having two high-resolution cameras. Honor's focus on video capabilities with its latest flagship is also noteworthy. Through its partnership with ARRI, the Magic9 Pro Max features advanced video recording capabilities, including LogC3 recording and 10-bit capture in ARRI Wide Gamut 3. However, they still lag behind dedicated GPUs in terms of performance. The AMD Radeon 780M is a notable example of an iGPU that can handle demanding workloads with ease. While integrated graphics have made significant strides, there are limitations to their capabilities. They typically rely on shared memory bandwidth with the central processing unit (CPU), which can impact overall system performance. Investing in a dedicated GPU may not be worth it for users who only engage in light productivity tasks or casual gaming. In such cases, an iGPU is more than sufficient to provide a seamless desktop experience. Dedicated GPUs are often the most expensive component in desktop computers, especially in gaming-focused builds. The decision to opt for a dedicated GPU or an iGPU ultimately depends on individual computing needs and requirements. Users who engage in demanding workloads or high-fidelity video games may benefit from the additional power provided by a dedicated GPU. Modern integrated GPUs have undergone significant improvements, allowing them to handle demanding tasks without bogging down a system. Yet, it's essential to note that not all CPUs come equipped with equally capable iGPUs. Some processors only support basic display output, while others can drive high-resolution displays and play casual games. The AMD Ryzen 7 8700G processor features the AMD Radeon 780M graphics with 12 compute units, making it a more robust option for GPU-intensive workloads compared to other CPUs. In contrast, the Ryzen 7 9800X3D processor comes with basic Radeon Graphics, consisting of only two compute units, which is surprisingly weaker in GPU-intensive scenarios despite its superior CPU performance. When building a desktop computer with an iGPU, users have options from both Intel and AMD at various price points. However, AMD currently leads the desktop iGPU market with its offerings providing substantial graphics-processing power over Intel's integrated graphics solutions. A dedicated graphics card is particularly beneficial for tasks that rely heavily on high-resolution video editing or high-fidelity gaming. This is because a discrete graphics card offers significantly more processing power than an iGPU, along with a separate and higher bandwidth memory pool that can alleviate memory-related bottlenecks common in iGPUs. As workloads increasingly demand more from the system, the limitations of iGPUs become apparent. A dedicated graphics card provides a more stable foundation for demanding tasks, ensuring smooth performance without the constraints imposed by integrated GPUs. Memory-related bottlenecks can significantly impact an integrated GPU's performance. The shared system memory configuration of iGPUs means that RAM speeds, configuration, and capacity all play a crucial role in determining overall system performance. This is evident from TechSpot's findings, where switching to slower DDR5-5200 RAM resulted in substantial performance drops on the Ryzen 7 8700G across multiple games. Upgrading your desktop computer can be a cost-effective way to breathe new life into an existing machine. If you initially built your PC with an integrated GPU but find yourself needing more processing power for demanding tasks, installing a dedicated graphics card can provide the necessary boost. However, before making any upgrades, it's essential to ensure that your power supply unit is capable of handling the increased load and that your case has sufficient clearance for the new component. Installing a powerful graphics card in your PC can be a straightforward process if you've done your homework beforehand. Verifying PCIe compatibility, checking the power supply capacity, and measuring the available space in your case are all crucial steps to take before upgrading your machine's GPU capabilities. articles.content: Steven Spielberg made a bold fashion statement at the Museum of Modern Art's annual Film Benefit on Thursday night, revealing the intricately designed lining of his bespoke Chanel tuxedo jacket to a packed audience. The custom-made jacket was crafted by Matthieu Blazy, who has been experimenting with personal flourishes in his designs. For his recent spring 2026 haute couture debut, Blazy asked models to contribute meaningful elements to their looks, which were then embroidered onto the garments or into little notes tucked inside Chanel handbags. The result was a series of exquisite and deeply personal creations that showcased the emotional connection between the models and their outfits. Stephanie Cavalli reportedly chose a love letter from her husband, which was beautifully translated into embroidery by the Lesage atelier. Blazy's focus on storytelling through garments has been a recurring theme in his designs. In the lead-up to the spring 2027 Chanel show, models discovered embroidered playing cards tucked inside jacket linings, featuring Gabrielle Chanel wearing looks that they had previously modeled on the runway. Personalization has become a hallmark of high-end fashion, with clients often requesting bespoke details that reflect their individuality. This trend is evident in the custom designs created for special occasions, such as Hailey Bieber's bubblegum-pink Chanel gown worn to the Academy Museum Gala last October, which featured a handwritten note with her son Jack's name and an arrow-pierced heart. While leaving personal messages inside garments may seem like a recent phenomenon, it has actually been practiced by designers for decades, often in subtle yet meaningful ways. Alexander McQueen, for instance, made a rebellious art of incorporating personal details into his designs, such as the locks of his own hair that he stitched into the linings of his 1992 graduate collection, Jack the Ripper Stalks His Victims. The clothing label itself has also long been a canvas for designers to express their personality and tell their brand's story, from elaborate cursive fonts to wacky illustrations and earnest mottos. A label can be more than just a straightforward declaration of ownership. It's an opportunity for designers to inject personality and whimsy into their creations. Sofia Testino is one such designer who has made this aspect of branding her specialty. Testino's eponymous label is a treasure trove of eccentricity, with each item bearing the mark of its maker in a unique and imaginative way. Her designs often evoke a sense of nostalgia, as if plucked from another era entirely. In one instance, shoeboxes adorned with cartoonish depictions of an ape transforming into a woman in high heels add a touch of playfulness to her brand's aesthetic. This approach is a far cry from the minimalist label design that has come to dominate the industry. Oscar Ouyang, a London-based knitwear designer, has found his own niche by incorporating a recurring motif, a sweet little lamb, into his designs and labels. The result is a whimsical collection of knits and clothing that are instantly recognizable as part of his brand. The emphasis on distinctive branding extends to collaborations between designers, such as the one between Devon Lee Carlson and Francesca Aiello for Frankies Bikinis. Vintage pieces from their own wardrobes were reimagined with sweet pink co-branded labels featuring a little dog and flowers, adding an extra layer of personality to the designs. Sinéad O'Dwyer has also been reassessing her brand identity as her customer base grows up alongside her. Her new logo is now integrated into the stitching on the back of her jeans, marking a deliberate shift towards a more mature aesthetic while retaining the essence of her original brand. A personal touch has become an integral part of London-based designer Ellie Misner's bespoke pieces. To commemorate special moments for her clients, Misner incorporates hand-embroidered names above her own handwritten logo on each garment. Misner's approach is evident in the details she adds to her custom designs. For instance, Raye's name was stitched in burgundy thread onto a crimson corseted gown, while Tems' signature was sewn in cobalt-blue onto the inside of a midnight-blue ensemble after their respective Glastonbury performances. Misner views her labels as an extension of her handwriting, often matching the embroidery thread to the garment's color. This thoughtful gesture makes each piece feel more than just a custom commission, especially for clients who've achieved milestones in their careers. As the fashion industry continues to evolve, it's refreshing to see labels emphasizing the human touch behind their designs. This shift towards personalization is a welcome respite from the prevailing trend of AI-generated images and algorithmically dictated taste. At Chanel's recent fall 2026 couture show, artist Joël Blanc brought an extra layer of authenticity to the event by painting the runway live in watercolors, capturing every detail in real-time. Similarly, Prada, Dior, and Bottega Veneta have all released new holiday campaigns that celebrate illustration and animation, injecting a sense of nostalgia into their marketing efforts. Prada's campaign stands out for its focus on hand-drawn artistry, with veteran animator John Pomeroy creating a whimsical winter wonderland populated by snow lynxes and mischievous mice. By embracing these traditional techniques, fashion labels are reminding us that there is inherent value in the unique qualities of human craftsmanship. articles.title: Long-period Radio Transients Sourced from White Dwarf Binary Systems
articles.summary: Astronomers have discovered a new source for long-period radio transients, which emit bright flashes of radio waves every few minutes to hours.
articles.content: Astronomers have been trying to understand a new type of cosmic object called long-period radio transients, which emit bright flashes of radio waves every few minutes to hours. These objects are believed to be linked to binary systems consisting of a small star called a red dwarf and a stellar remnant known as a white dwarf. Research published in Nature Astronomy reveals the first discovery of a different source for one of these enigmatic broadcasters: it involves a white dwarf, but this time with a partner that closely resembles our own sun. The finding sheds new light on the mystery surrounding long-period radio transients. Scientists began investigating natural explanations after initially ruling out extraterrestrial sources for these intermittent signals. One theory suggested they might be neutron star pulsars, which are collapsed cores of massive stars producing repeating radio flashes. The idea that slow-spinning neutron stars could produce radio waves was deemed unlikely in some models, prompting a search for alternative explanations. The discovery of the new source with a sun-like companion offers a fresh perspective on these enigmatic objects and their origins. Further research is needed to confirm whether this finding represents a broader phenomenon or an isolated case, but it already points towards a more nuanced understanding of long-period radio transients. The breakthrough came when researchers were able to trace the origin of these repeating radio signals back to their sources. One signal stood out as coming from a red dwarf star that likely orbits a white dwarf. The white dwarf is believed to be the remnant of a star similar to our sun, which has exhausted its fuel and shed its outer layers. The pattern that emerged across several long-period transients whose source stars could be identified was striking. In each case, the system consisted of a binary pair: a small, cool red dwarf paired with a white dwarf. This pairing is significant because it suggests that these systems may be more common than previously thought. Researchers were conducting a survey using the Murchison Widefield Array radio telescope in Western Australia when they stumbled upon something unusual. In late 2024, they employed a search method developed by doctoral student Csanád Horváth to scan for new long-period transients. The method proved effective, as it allowed them to detect short flashes of radio waves that appeared at regular intervals. These flashes arrived approximately every 7.9 minutes and were seen during a narrow window of about six hours. For the remaining 26 hours, no pulses were detected. This pattern is most likely explained by the presence of two stars in orbit around each other once every 32 hours, with the radio pulses visible only when they are aligned correctly. The MeerKAT telescope in South Africa pinpointed the source of the radio waves to a small region of the sky containing a single faint star. Further investigation by the Keck telescope in Hawaii revealed that this star is not a tiny red dwarf, but rather a G-type star with similar mass and temperature to our own sun. To confirm that the pulsing object is indeed a star and not a neutron star, astronomers analyzed the timing of the radio pulses. The pulses arrive up to 4 seconds earlier or later than expected due to the varying distance they travel around their orbit. The precise spectrum "fingerprint" of the sunlike star shows minimal wobbling as it orbits its partner, indicating that the sunlike star must be significantly heavier than the pulsing object. Measuring the size of the orbit, the time it takes for each orbit to complete, and combining these with the spectrum measurements allow astronomers to calculate the mass of the pulsing object. The result is that the pulsing object weighs about two-thirds as much as the sun, ruling out the possibility that it's a neutron star. A white dwarf pulsar has been discovered orbiting a star similar to the sun, marking a significant find in the field of astronomy. The unusual pairing is thought to have originated from a star that expanded into a giant and engulfed its companion, causing it to spiral inward and shrink its orbit before shedding its outer layers. This process likely occurred relatively recently in cosmic terms, making systems like this quite common throughout the universe. However, detecting these white dwarfs next to bright stars is extremely challenging due to the overwhelming glare of the latter obscuring the faint light emanating from the former. Fortunately, radio pulses can cut through the intense radiation emitted by the brighter star, allowing astronomers to detect and study these elusive objects that would otherwise remain invisible to optical and X-ray telescopes. Astronomers believe that discovering more white dwarf binaries could provide valuable insights into the lives and deaths of stars like our own sun, particularly in relation to Type Ia supernovae, which are thought to be the remnants of such systems. Astronomers have made an intriguing discovery involving a white dwarf binary system, where one star emits radio waves every 8 minutes while its companion closely resembles our sun. The white dwarf's rhythmic pulses are thought to be caused by the intense gravitational pull of its companion, which is likely a red giant. This phenomenon could provide valuable insights into the lives and deaths of stars like our own sun, particularly in relation to Type Ia supernovae. The discovery highlights the importance of continued research into binary star systems. The white dwarf's pulses are being studied by astronomers who believe that understanding their behavior will help them better grasp the processes involved in the evolution of single stars. articles.content: SpaceX's Starship spacecraft successfully landed back on Earth after a 22-hour journey in space, completing its first mid-air catch by giant robot arms at a facility in Texas. The capture was a major milestone for Elon Musk and his team, who had hoped to achieve the feat with both the booster and the spacecraft returning safely. Despite this setback, the Starship itself made it back intact. The dramatic capture was a crucial step towards demonstrating the full reusability of the Starship, which is designed for missions to the moon and Mars. The technique had already been validated through three previous successful booster catches, but Saturday's feat marked its first application to a returning spacecraft. Wreckage from the failed booster recovery attempt remains in the Gulf of Mexico, cordoned off by buoys, while the Starship was successfully lowered upright at the launch pad following its return. NASA has expressed satisfaction with the outcome of Saturday's mission, which saw Starship successfully complete a mid-air catch after returning from orbit. The space agency is investing heavily in the project, with billions of dollars allocated to support Starship's role in landing Artemis astronauts on the moon and establishing a permanent lunar base. This ambitious endeavor aligns with NASA's long-term goals for space exploration. The maiden orbital flight of this massive rocket was a remarkable achievement, with the 407-foot behemoth lifting off from SpaceX's launch site near the U.S.-Mexican border late Friday afternoon. The separation of the booster and upper-stage spacecraft proceeded smoothly, paving the way for the insertion into orbit and deployment of 26 cutting-edge Starlink satellites. The autonomous Starship continued to circle the globe at an altitude of approximately 165 miles, with live video feeds transmitted via Starlink providing breathtaking views of the Earth from space. During its 14 orbits around our planet, this spacecraft surpassed previous missions in terms of duration and complexity. articles.content: A shocking scandal has rocked the tech world, leading to the sudden resignation of Jensen Huang, cofounder and CEO of Nvidia, a leading AI company in the US. The allegations against Huang centered around his alleged affair with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman who worked for a company that purchased billions of dollars' worth of Nvidia's high-performance AI chips. The same company has been under investigation due to concerns about potential misuse of these products. This revelation led to Huang's swift departure from the company, and the sudden loss of $300 billion in market value. However, new information is emerging that raises questions about the validity of the central claim in this scandal. Several reputable news outlets have published reports suggesting that the spy allegations against Alice Huang may be exaggerated or even fabricated. If true, this would imply a more complex motive behind Huang's resignation than initially thought. US intelligence agencies reportedly have not confirmed whether Alice Huang was indeed working as a Chinese spy. Some CIA officials are questioning whether intercepted communications provide conclusive proof that Alice Huang knowingly passed information to Beijing. An open letter has been circulating online calling for Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO until this matter is clarified. The letter, which has garnered over 100,000 signatures from top executives and current employees, demands evidence substantiating the spy allegations against the woman at the center of this controversy. According to a report in The Washington Post, Secretary of State Marco Rubio took a less conclusive CIA intelligence report and rewrote it in more assertive language to warn President Donald Trump about Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Rubio's memo was eventually leaked, and its findings are said to have set off the chain of events that led to Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia after 33 years at the helm. A growing number of questions have been raised about the accuracy of the intelligence on Alice Huang, a researcher accused of being a Chinese spy. The allegations against her led to Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, stepping down after 33 years at the helm. This development has sparked concerns that the intelligence was exaggerated or even fabricated to justify tougher restrictions on China. A similar situation occurred in 2003 when US Secretary of State Colin Powell presented intelligence to the United Nations on Iraq's alleged possession of weapons of mass destruction. Powell's warnings were based on intelligence assessments, but after the invasion, investigators found no evidence of such stockpiles. The failure has been attributed to a combination of flawed intelligence, political pressure, and selective use of evidence. A key lesson from this experience is that intelligence can be presented with more certainty than the underlying evidence supports, especially when powerful people have a policy goal in mind. In the case of Powell's presentation, it was clear that the Bush administration wanted to invade Iraq, and the claims about weapons of mass destruction helped build support for that decision. The parallels between this episode and the allegations against Alice Huang are striking, with both cases involving intelligence assessments that may have been exaggerated or manipulated. To understand the possible motives behind these actions, it's essential to examine the broader context in which they occurred. A bitter fight has been underway inside Washington over China's access to Nvidia technology, particularly its most powerful AI chips used for advanced artificial intelligence development. Implementing restrictions on chip sales to China has turned out to be a challenging task for US authorities. A key factor hindering enforcement is the rise of cloud computing, which allows companies to access powerful AI chips without physically possessing them in mainland China. This works by an American company selling its AI chips to a data center operator outside China, who then rents out the computing power over the internet to customers, including Chinese firms. The fact that these transactions can be legitimate under existing US rules has raised concerns among Washington officials that this is a loophole undermining the restrictions on chip sales to China. They are now seeking to close this gap in regulations. The sudden ousting of Nvidia's CEO is beginning to unravel as a complex web of politics and regulation. A closer look at Alice Huang's past reveals that she was an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company under investigation for possible US export restrictions violations since 2024. US officials have been scrutinizing the company, which purchased nearly $2 billion worth of Nvidia technology, raising concerns about potential security risks. The New York Times published a detailed investigation into Megaspeed on October 9, 2025, highlighting Alice Huang's close relationship with Jensen Huang and her access to sensitive information. As the US government tightens its grip on Chinese companies' access to American tech, lawmakers are pushing for legislation that restricts remote access to powerful chips located in other countries. The sudden departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has sparked intense scrutiny over allegations of Chinese espionage and US intelligence involvement. Some experts now question whether the US government's actions were truly aimed at protecting national security or if they were motivated by other factors. A closer examination of recent events reveals a series of coincidences that raise suspicions about the role of US intelligence in Huang's ousting. CNN's reporting and the Washington Post's article on Rubio's memo have added fuel to the debate, highlighting potential inconsistencies in the narrative presented by US officials. While there are valid arguments on both sides of the issue, concerns persist over the possible misuse of intelligence information to bring down a key industry leader. If it is indeed true that US officials exaggerated or manipulated intelligence to achieve their goals, this would not only be an embarrassment for the government but also potentially damage America's lead in AI research and development. Ultimately, the public deserves transparency and clarity on these matters, especially given the high stakes involved in the intersection of national security and cutting-edge technology. articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Offers Improved Performance and Battery Life Range
articles.summary: The new console brings with it improved performance capabilities compared to its predecessor, but battery life varies significantly depending on game type and settings used.
articles.content: The Nintendo Switch 2 has finally arrived on the scene, bringing with it improved performance capabilities compared to its predecessor. This new console is capable of handling modern games comfortably, making a significant leap forward from the original in terms of chipset power. However, one notable tradeoff for this enhanced performance is battery life. Unlike many other gaming handhelds that provide a specific estimate of battery duration, Nintendo gives a range of hours instead - 2 to 6.5 hours on a full charge in handheld or tabletop mode. The actual battery life can vary significantly depending on the type of games played and console settings used; for instance, processor-intensive 3D games will require more frequent charging due to their demanding nature. Adjusting screen brightness is one of the simplest ways to prolong the life of a Nintendo Switch 2 battery. The top end of the slider should be avoided unless there's no other way to see what's happening on the screen. The display's brightness can have a significant impact on battery drain, making it an area worth optimizing for longer gaming sessions. To adjust the brightness, pressing and holding the Home button on the controller brings up the Quick Settings menu, where the slider can be adjusted as needed. Alternatively, users can access the System Settings menu by navigating to Screen Brightness. This allows for a more deliberate approach to setting the display's brightness level. The automatic brightness setting built into the system is designed to adjust the display's brightness based on the surrounding environment. However, this feature may not always provide optimal results, particularly in games with dark environments that require a lower brightness setting. Having Wi-Fi turned on can also contribute to battery drain, as the console constantly scans for available networks to connect to, even when playing offline. Disabling Wi-Fi when not needed can help extend the life of the Switch 2's battery. Disabling Airplane Mode or going into System Settings to manually enable it can help reduce unnecessary communication on your Nintendo Switch 2 when not needed. When Airplane Mode is enabled, you can still customize which features work while it's on. For instance, you might choose to keep Bluetooth active so you can continue using wireless headphones while turning off Wi-Fi to conserve battery life. The Amiibo feature requires NFC, and since it's likely not essential when trying to extend battery life, it's a good idea to disable it if possible. This will help minimize the drain on your Switch 2's battery. Another power-hungry feature is HD Rumble 2 technology, which uses motors that can quickly deplete your battery. Turning off this feature in System Settings > Controllers & Accessories > Controller Vibration while playing in handheld mode can reclaim some lost energy without significantly impacting gameplay. Reducing the volume when playing games without headphones can also help conserve power. This simple adjustment won't have a major impact on your gaming experience but will contribute to extending battery life. System Settings allow you to review and adjust other power-hungry features like the display's native 120Hz refresh rate and HDR output. Disabling these in System Settings > Display, specifically 120Hz Output and HDR output, can help save some battery life. The Nintendo Switch 2's battery charging mechanism is designed to prevent long-term damage by limiting the charge level. This feature, which stops charging at around 90 percent, may seem counterintuitive, but it serves a crucial purpose: protecting the battery from degradation when left in a fully charged state for extended periods. For users who leave their Switch 2 docked most of the time, this setting should be enabled to mitigate battery deterioration. Handheld players, on the other hand, might not need to worry about enabling this feature if they store their console in a protective case when not in use. The graphic requirements of demanding games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077 can quickly drain the Switch 2's battery, especially when playing in handheld mode. When playing graphically simpler indie games or 2D platformers on the Nintendo Switch 2, battery life tends to be more manageable. These types of games are not only more power-efficient but also perfectly suited for portable play. Considering the console's portability feature as one of its main selling points, it makes sense to prioritize these lighter games in your backlog when you're away from a power source. If you find yourself frequently needing extra battery life, investing in a good power bank can be a worthwhile solution. articles.content: Apple has introduced a feature in its AirPods Pro earbuds that allows users to conduct a hearing test in just five minutes. This feature is available on the latest models of AirPods Pro and requires iOS 18.1 or later. The hearing test feature, which Apple claims is "clinical-grade, can help identify potential hearing loss, regardless of age. It's worth noting that while commercially available health devices may not always provide accurate results, Apple's hearing test has shown promise in delivering reliable outcomes under the right conditions. To use the feature, simply open the Settings app on your iPhone and select AirPods Pro from the list of connected devices. From there, you can access the hearing test by navigating to the Hearing section within the device settings. The test itself is straightforward, requiring users to sit in a quiet room with their AirPods Pro inserted. While some may be skeptical about relying on an earbuds-based hearing test, Apple's feature has been shown to deliver accurate results when used as intended. But it's essential to remember that this test is not meant to replace professional medical evaluations and should only be seen as a starting point for further assessment by an audiologist or healthcare professional. The AirPods Pro's hearing test has undergone scrutiny since its release, including a clinical study on its accuracy. Researchers conducted a 2026 study published in Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery, which found that the AirPods Pro showed clinically acceptable accuracy and reliability" when compared against standard audiometry tests. The study highlighted the convenience of the AirPods Pro's hearing test, noting it is significantly faster and easier to perform than an in-office exam. This ease of use could encourage more people to prioritize their hearing health, but it's essential to remember that this test is not a substitute for professional medical evaluations. While Apple's hearing test is considered a valid screening tool, it cannot provide a diagnosis, only a doctor can do that. The test is also limited in scope compared to an audiologist's comprehensive evaluation, which includes additional tests to measure bone conduction and eardrum health. These extra assessments offer a more complete understanding of one's hearing and can pinpoint the cause of any loss. Studies on the AirPods Pro's accuracy have been small so far, but their findings are still significant. The limitations of the AirPods Pro's hearing test underscore the importance of consulting an audiologist or healthcare professional for a thorough evaluation. The AirPods Pro can serve as a starting point for further assessment, but it should not replace professional medical evaluations. To get an accurate reading from the AirPods Pro, it is essential to take the hearing test under optimal conditions. This means ensuring that the ear tips form a complete seal in your ears, and finding the right fit can sometimes be a challenge. A quiet environment without background noise is also crucial for obtaining reliable results. The AirPods Pro will alert you if it detects excessive noise or an inadequate in-ear fit during the test. However, even with these precautions, taking the test at home may not be as effective as undergoing a professional evaluation at a doctor's office. The hearing test provided by the AirPods Pro is designed to screen for age-related normal hearing loss, which affects most people to some extent. If you experience sudden hearing deterioration or ear pain, or if one ear is significantly worse than the other, it is vital to consult a medical professional promptly. In such cases, Apple's hearing test can serve as an initial screening tool before symptoms arise, but it should not be relied upon for definitive diagnosis or treatment. articles.summary: Tens of thousands of protesters took to the streets in France on Saturday, venting their frustrations over a range of issues including the rising cost of living and a proposed law that would give police greater legal protection.
articles.content: Tens of thousands of protesters took to the streets in France on Saturday, venting their frustrations over a range of issues including the rising cost of living and a proposed law that would give police greater legal protection. The protests, which have been ongoing for more than a month, saw demonstrators clamber up statues and hold French flags as they marched through the country's cities. The European Union's second-largest economy has been gripped by high-school blockades and mass demonstrations, with the far right leading in the polls ahead of next year's presidential elections. Protesters were out in force across France, with estimates suggesting that between 106,000 and 200,000 people took part. Student unions reported a higher turnout than the interior ministry, putting the number of demonstrators at around 200,000 nationwide, including almost 100,000 in Paris. The protests have been marked by some incidents, but arrest figures were lower than in previous demonstrations, with the interior ministry reporting that 219 people had been detained across the nation and Paris prosecutors saying 45 were arrested in the capital. The Paris protests have become a familiar sight on Saturdays, with demonstrators from various groups coming together to express their discontent. Students, union members, and Yellow Vest activists joined forces, their message clear: "No justice, no peace. The crowds were vocal in their criticism of the government, with some calling for President Macron's resignation. A giant puppet bearing a hat reading Lord Macron made an appearance at one rally, while others chanted Everybody hates the police. The atmosphere was largely peaceful, but there have been instances of fringe violence and allegations of police brutality. Young teenagers were among those reportedly affected by excessive force. One musician, Adrien, spoke out against a new bill in parliament that would grant police greater protection if they use their weapons. As a 20-year-old cello player with the Paris rally's volunteer orchestra, he expressed concern about the impact on protesters' safety. The recent incident where tear gas fell on musicians during a protest had left him shaken. The proposed law has sparked debate, with some arguing that it would shield police from accountability. Backers of the bill, including Marine Le Pen's far-right party, claim it is necessary to prevent officers from being automatically suspected of using excessive force in self-defence situations. The protests across France are not just about police brutality, but also about holding security forces accountable for their actions. Activists argue that the proposed bill would make it even harder to investigate and prosecute officers who use excessive force in self-defence situations. In a country where alleged police brutality cases rarely reach a criminal court, the bill's backers claim it is necessary to prevent officers from being automatically suspected of using excessive force. However, critics warn that this would amount to a licence to kill and undermine efforts to ensure justice and accountability. Meanwhile, protests in various cities have taken on diverse forms, with some focusing on specific issues such as better learning conditions for children or increased rights for minors. In the southwestern city of Bordeaux, elderly residents like 72-year-old Josette joined in, singing protest songs like I have two passions: brass bands and revolution to show their support. Protesters are drawing attention to a range of social and economic issues that they believe are being ignored by the government. With President Macron's popularity at an all-time low according to recent polls, and the centre-right struggling to present a strong contender in next year's elections, the government has limited room for manoeuvre. Protesters in Toulouse expressed outrage at the government's handling of the social unrest, with one asylum law specialist speaking out against police brutality. Kenza, a 28-year-old expert on refugee rights, condemned the authorities' response to peaceful demonstrations. The repression of protesters is unacceptable, even more so when they are children," she emphasized. Eyewitness accounts from Lyon revealed that police were forced to intervene to protect a team of television journalists who came under attack by protesters. This incident highlights the increasingly volatile nature of the protests, which have been marked by clashes between demonstrators and law enforcement. Unions have also criticized the government's proposed increase in the minimum wage, calling it insufficient. The government faces mounting pressure as unions plan another day of strikes on Tuesday, following last week's massive protest, where over half a million people took to the streets nationwide. The union-led strike was one of the largest in recent weeks, with widespread participation across the country. In response to these developments, it appears that the government has limited room for manoeuvre amidst growing public discontent and calls for change. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy provided further insight into the government's response, stating that a conference call was convened with key officials from the national security apparatus. These included FBI Director Kash Patel and the director of national intelligence, as well as representatives from the Defense Department. The purpose of this meeting was to assess the threat level posed by the telecom issue. The investigation revealed that there was no indication of a cyberattack or hacking attempt. Once the location of the problem was isolated and taken offline, the air-traffic control system began functioning properly again. The investigation into the FAA telecom problems that led to the ground stop revealed an unexpected cause: routine maintenance work by a contractor at a remote location. A contractor with L3Harris was carrying out a switch from old copper wire to fiber optics when the issue arose, according to Duffy. The process involved transferring telecommunication lines to more modern and efficient systems. The decision to upgrade the infrastructure was likely aimed at improving communication reliability and reducing the risk of disruptions in the future. However, this specific update seems to have had an unintended consequence. The incident highlights the importance of thorough testing and quality control measures during such maintenance work to prevent unforeseen problems from arising. The telecom upgrade at the FAA's air traffic control system was supposed to be a routine maintenance task, but it had an unexpected consequence. Routers across the system were overwhelmed by more than 1,000 connection attempts every four to five seconds, disrupting some radar feeds and prompting the FAA to order a ground stop for safety reasons. To determine the cause of the problem, investigators are trying to establish whether it was due to user error or a faulty router installed by L3Harris, which owns the legacy telecom network. The department is working with top telecommunications companies like AT&T, Verizon, and Lumens to build a new architecture that will eventually replace the outdated system. Duffy emphasized that L3Harris is accountable for its performance as prime contractor, warning that the department will hold people responsible if they fail to meet expectations. The company behind the National Airspace System's communication infrastructure has been working to modernize it in close collaboration with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). As part of this effort, L3Harris and its telecom partners have made significant progress in replacing legacy copper wires with a more reliable fiber optic system, completing over 70% of the conversion.
